source:src/map/packets/inventory_item.cpp:48 (m_extra copied into the 0x020 item packet)

source:src/map/lua/lua_trade_container.cpp (method list: no per-slot item/extra accessor; getItem/getItemId/getSlotCount only)
findings.note: Source-read only. Egg/card items exist and the generic 24-byte extra blob persists and is sent to the client, but there is no ChocoboEgg/ChocoboCard exdata struct, no Lua getExData/setExData, and no way for an NPC onTrade script to read a traded item's extra bytes. Item-to-item bit layout (DNA1-3/Ability/Plan/IsBred) cannot be applied until those accessors exist. LSB ref: src/map/items/exdata/chocobo_egg.h, chocobo_card.cpp (commit 73e01519). Not runtime tested; inventory-save paths other than insert (e.g. quantity-only UpdateItem) not audited for extra preservation on stack/move.

findings.name: NPC packet sequences
evidence: source:src/map/packets/event.cpp:5-60 (0x032/0x034, eight u32 params, ActIndex/EventNum/Mode at LSB-equivalent offsets)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.cpp:2857-2930 (startEvent: EventID + up to 8 params + optional textTable arg 10; argument-count guard n>10)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.h:214-216 (startEventString 0x033, updateEvent, updateEventString)
source:src/map/packet_system.cpp:2626-2650 (0x05B: EndPara@0x08, Mode@0x0E, EventPara@0x12; Mode!=0 -> onEventUpdate else onEventFinish; EventID must match m_event)
source:src/map/packet_system.cpp:2631-2634 (m_event.Option overrides the client's EndPara when nonzero)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.h:274-275 (tradeComplete, confirmTrade), packet_system 0x036 trade path
findings.note: Source-read only. The generic event start/update/finish, string-event and trade machinery match the field layout of LSB's GP_SERV_COMMAND_EVENTNUM (8 nums) and GP_CLI_COMMAND_EVENTEND, so no new packet classes appear to be required for the trainer menus; this is NOT proof that the chocobo option sequence works. Specific risks: (1) m_event.Option sticky override can swallow option values the VM reads; (2) LSB's event_playout relies on a dedicated Mode=UpdatePending flow and startEventString for naming/debug; DSP has startEventString but the name-entry reply fields were never exercised; (3) retail/capture evidence for the actual trainer sequence is absent in this repo; check <local>/Playthrough Captures for chocobo raising captures first. Per CLAUDE.md, startEvent padding must follow capture evidence per csid.

source:src/map/packets/zone_in.cpp:151 (hard-coded 0xD4 at 0x5E)
source:scripts/globals/keyitems.lua:144 (CHOCOBO_LICENSE = 138)
findings.note: Source-read only. Rental mount, License check and zone gating work in source. Personal chocobo is missing entirely: no ChocoboCustomProperties bitfield (beak/talons/tail/color/speed/minutes), no mountutils equivalent, no MOUNTED subPower personal flag (LSB 0x40), no ChocoboIndex 2 packet path, and speed/time are constants. LSB ref: src/map/utils/mountutils.{h,cpp}, packets/char_update.cpp:283-300, char_sync.cpp:55-57, battle_entity.cpp:360, charutils.cpp:2046/3180. The DSP 0x00D layout is the older fixed-offset writer, so the LSB bit layout for the mount fields must be re-derived/captured for this client build (CLIENT_VER 30170905_5) before use. Existing whistle behaviour must be preserved when no registered chocobo exists.
